sources.fact: Authoritative current Brownfield entity is LBBD72/ZZ, GSR and Gill Sites.
The current record gives 707 minimum and maximum net dwellings on 2.55ha.
The record is permissioned with full-planning-permission type.
The record marks the site deliverable.
Ownership-status is owned-by-a-public-authority; this is not a current named proprietor/title readback.
The record supplies a point and blank geometry rather than exact title/application polygons.
Regulation 19 HTML identifies ZZ - GSR & Gill Sites Chequers Lane as a Local Plan allocation attachment.
Regulation 19 approval is plan-making provenance and not a site planning permission.
The separate former Ford Stamping Plant outline case proposed up to 3,502 homes and is not transferred to ZZ's 707.
Dagenham Green Phase 1 reserved matters comprised 935 dwellings on Plots A-C; this is not added to ZZ.
A separate land-north-of-Dagenham-Dock-Station proposal described 380 homes and adjacent GSR storage/Station Square works; nearby evidence is not parcel identity.
No exact topology reconciling ZZ's two planning-history links, nearby schemes and HMLR titles was verified this wave.

examples.result: ZZ remains a current 707-home permissioned Brownfield record.
The 3,502-home former Ford Stamping outline scheme is not transferred to ZZ.
The 935-home Dagenham Green Phase 1 is not added to 707.
The separate 380-home station-area proposal is blocked by scope/address collision rules.
Local Plan allocation identity is not planning permission finality.
Public-authority ownership category is not a current named proprietor relation.
The Brownfield point is not converted into HMLR geometry.
Promotion remains zero until exact case-to-parcel/title topology and overlays are verified.
